headline: AI Engineer — product and platform
summary: AI Engineer on the founding team at Colligence Research in Bengaluru. I build the product — agentic and LLM pipelines, code-generation services, backend APIs — and I own the platform it runs on: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, incident response and auth. The combination is the point: the person who ships the agent workflow is the person who carries the pager for it.

about.title: What I build
about.body: Multi-agent LLM pipelines for ERP automation over MCP, a code-generation service that turns structured input specs into deployment-ready web applications, and the backend APIs behind them. Long-running, multi-step agent workflows that stay on track without a human babysitting them.

about.title: What I run
about.body: The platform those systems run on. I established the DevOps/SRE function at Colligence Research from scratch and lead it: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code with OpenTofu and Ansible on Linode, Docker, Zitadel for SSO and RBAC, observability, alerting and incident runbooks.

about.title: Research and publications
about.body: Three peer-reviewed papers — one at Springer ICTIS 2025 in Bangkok and two on IEEE Xplore — covering school administration systems, ResNet50 hyperparameter tuning and a web-server controlled rover with object detection. Two more are under review.

projects.title: Arogya-Sathi
projects.subtitle: Offline-capable multilingual AI healthcare platform
projects.description: Symptom checking, X-ray fracture detection, prescription summarisation and a wellness chatbot, running fully offline on quantized models — demonstrated on a Raspberry Pi. A deterministic rule-based drug-interaction and crisis-detection safety layer sits underneath and the LLM cannot override it. A 62-case labelled evaluation harness scores those safety layers and runs as a CI merge gate at recall 1.00; building it found a real missed self-harm disclosure. A LangGraph pipeline turns an uploaded medical report into a plain-language explanation in the patient's own language, with a self-verification loop, and requests are routed across local Ollama models. Third place, college final-year showcase.
